newsitem.title: USA: CalEnergy remains committed to NYSEG merger.
newsitem.headline: CalEnergy remains committed to NYSEG merger.

text.p: CalEnergy Co Inc said Wednesday it remains committed to its plan to acquire New York State Electric & Gas Corp despite the NYSEG board's rejection of CalEnergy's unsolicited offer.

"We intend to pursue this transaction in spite of the board's decision, complete our 9.9 percent tender offer and move forward aggressively on our NYSEG acquisition plan," CalEnergy chairman and chief executive David Sokol said in a press release.

NYSEG said earlier Wednesday its board had rejected CalEnergy's cash tender offer for more than 6.5 million NYSEG shares at a price of $24.50. The company also said it would not pursue cash merger negotiations with CalEnergy at $27.50 per share.
NYSEG said it concluded the proposal was not in the best interests of the company or its shareholders, customers, employees and other constituencies.
